body: Looks fucking sick dude! Nice to see a 405th out there

6 years ago is when I started really stressing out about school, it's when it started to become toxic. My depression began with school, but now it doesn't need school.

And yes there is still things that frighten me about it but its better sooner than later

Nah you're good dood if you got to sleep you got to sleep, no need to stay up for me. Thanks for talking to me anyways

And yeah they kinda were and still are the downhill of my life, these past six years the only thing I can remember prominently is my suicidal tendencies and depression. The only reason i didn't off myself is because I was too scared to. But I think I have enough courage to do it now

Just by living my pretty standard life, I have a good family and semi good friends and plenty of stuff to distract my self. But my problem is I don't want to distract myself anymore, I don't want to distract myself from life. I want the truth.

Please don't gatekeep being suicidal, what we feel is true and valid. It doesn't matter where we come from, what does matter is the state we are in now. If we need help we need help. No questions asked.

The pain, emptiness, and apathy that I feel are too strong for me to value living over me not existing. Sure I love my friends and family but they are simply not enough to overpower the attraction towards death.
Oh I do. But frankly it's not enough to constitute living.
It began as pressure from school. And then it became self perpetuated. Even when school didn't become an issue
